findings.detail: Description of "registry_join" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: registry_verify · Private data: registry_join, registry_confirm_key, registry_verify · Public sink: registry_join, registry_confirm_key · Destructive: registry_join.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: registry_verify · Private data: registry_join, registry_confirm_key, registry_verify · Public sink: registry_join, registry_confirm_key · Destructive: registry_join

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
